## getAccountStatus

Get Whatsapp Account Status. `GET /whatsapp/channels/{channel_id}/account-status`

Get WhatsApp Business Account status including billing/payment info.

This endpoint helps diagnose issues like "Business eligibility payment issue" by checking the WABA configuration and phone number status.

```php
$sendseven->whatsApp()->getAccountStatus(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/get_whatsapp_account_status_api_v1_whatsapp_channels__channel_id__account_status_get)

## getCoexistenceStatus

Get Coexistence Status. `GET /whatsapp/channels/{channel_id}/coexistence-status`

Get WhatsApp Coexistence sync status for a channel.

Polled by the frontend after a user finishes the Coexistence onboarding branch. Returns the current history-backfill and address-book sync state plus any disconnection signals received via account_update webhooks.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsApp()->getCoexistenceStatus(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `CoexistenceStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/get_coexistence_status_api_v1_whatsapp_channels__channel_id__coexistence_status_get)

## listFlows

List Whatsapp Flows. `GET /whatsapp/channels/{channel_id}/flows`

List available WhatsApp Flows for a channel

Retrieves the flows of the channel's WhatsApp Business Account from Meta. Flows built in SendSeven carry definition_id / definition_status. Flows of ARCHIVED SendSeven WhatsApp Flows are hidden unless include_archived=true; Meta flows superseded by "publish changes" are always hidden (they no longer serve new sends).

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsApp()->listFlows(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$includeArchived` | `?bool` | no | Also list Meta flows whose SendSeven WhatsApp Flow is archived |

Returns `FetchFlows`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/list_whatsapp_flows_api_v1_whatsapp_channels__channel_id__flows_get)

## getFlowDetails

Get Whatsapp Flow Details. `GET /whatsapp/channels/{channel_id}/flows/{flow_id}`

Get detailed information about a specific WhatsApp Flow

Returns the flow's screens (with input fields, the raw data declaration as data_schema, and whether the screen is terminal), the entry screen, whether the flow is static (no data endpoint — first-screen data must be sent with the message), and the saved default data per screen.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsApp()->getFlowDetails(channelId: 'channel_id', flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$refresh` | `?bool` | no | Bypass the cached flow JSON and re-download it from Meta |

Returns `FlowDetails`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/get_whatsapp_flow_details_api_v1_whatsapp_channels__channel_id__flows__flow_id__get)

## updateFlowDefaults

Update Whatsapp Flow Defaults. `PUT /whatsapp/channels/{channel_id}/flows/{flow_id}/defaults`

Save the default data for one screen of a WhatsApp Flow.

The saved data is used whenever this flow is sent without explicit data (from the conversation composer or as a template FLOW button). Send data: null to remove the saved default for that screen.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsApp()->updateFlowDefaults(channelId: 'channel_id', flowId: 'flow_id', screen: 'screen');
```

- Scopes: `channels:update`

|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$screen` | `string` | yes | Screen id |
| `$data` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Default data for the screen; null removes the saved default |

Returns `UpdateFlowDefaults`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/update_whatsapp_flow_defaults_api_v1_whatsapp_channels__channel_id__flows__flow_id__defaults_put)

## getSendingLimit

Get Whatsapp Sending Limit. `GET /whatsapp/channels/{channel_id}/sending-limit`

Get a WhatsApp channel's persisted *sending limit* (messaging tier).

Lean replacement for the live-fetching /account-status endpoint on the Settings → Channels page. Instead of hitting Meta on every page open, this endpoint serves a value persisted onto the channel's encrypted config and re-queries the provider at most once per 24h per channel (server-side, authoritative gate). Safe to call on every page load: it is idempotent and cheap, and it NEVER 500s the page — a provider/token failure degrades to the last-known value with stale=True and a soft error.

```php
$sendseven->whatsApp()->getSendingLimit(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/get_whatsapp_sending_limit_api_v1_whatsapp_channels__channel_id__sending_limit_get)

## getCallWindow

Get Whatsapp Call Window. `GET /whatsapp/conversations/{conversation_id}/call-window`

Whether an OUTBOUND WhatsApp call can be placed on this conversation now, plus the call-permission window expiry (Feature #34 backend half).

Mirrors /conversations/{id}/whatsapp-window (the 24h MESSAGING window) but for the CALL-permission window. WhatsApp's business-initiated calling requires an open call-permission window — granted by the customer (a permission grant or a prior connected call) and lasting 7 days (168h). The "Call" button in the conversation view gates on this.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsApp()->getCallWindow(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `calls:view`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `array<array-key, mixed>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/get_whatsapp_call_window_api_v1_whatsapp_conversations__conversation_id__call_window_get)

## getWindowStatus

Get Whatsapp Window Status. `GET /whatsapp/conversations/{conversation_id}/whatsapp-window`

Get WhatsApp messaging window status for a conversation

WhatsApp Business API restricts sending free-form messages outside a window after the last customer message. This endpoint returns the current window status so the UI can gate free-form vs template composition.


## sendFlow

Send Whatsapp Flow. `POST /whatsapp/flows/send`

Send a WhatsApp Flow message (free-form, inside the 24-hour window)

The recipient is resolved from conversation_id (preferred), contact_id or recipient (phone number). Contacts without a phone number that are reachable via a WhatsApp business-scoped user ID are supported.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsApp()->sendFlow(channelId: 'channel_id', flowId: 'flow_id', flowCta: 'flow_cta');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | Channel ID to send from |
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes | WhatsApp Flow ID |
| `$flowCta` | `string` | yes | Button text to trigger flow (max 30 chars) |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no | Contact ID to send to |
| `$recipient` | `?string` | no | Recipient phone number (alternative to contact_id) |
| `$body` | `?string` | no | Message body text |
| `$header` | `?string` | no | Optional header text |
| `$footer` | `?string` | no | Optional footer text |
| `$screen` | `?string` | no | Initial screen to navigate to |
| `$data` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Data for the first screen. When omitted, the saved default data for (flow_id, screen) is used. String values may contain contact variables such as {{contact.first_name}} or {{contact.custom.<key>}}; they are rendered per recipient. |
| `$mode` | `FlowMode\|string\|null` | no | Flow mode: draft or published |
| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no | Conversation to send into. Resolves the recipient and channel context; takes precedence over contact_id / recipient. |
| `$flowToken` | `?string` | no | Optional tracking token (auto-generated if not provided) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SendFlow`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/send_whatsapp_flow_api_v1_whatsapp_flows_send_post)
